'''Ran Harva''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] who served with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was the younger of her two co-Senators for the Bormea sector. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Ran's wife was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]] was attacked by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd's]] superweapon and he returned to Chandrila in mourning.
